descriptions: They wear a bell-and-patch limiter to suppress their massive spiritual pressure.
The only captain to get the job without passing the mandatory Bankai exam.
Their surname comes from the lawless 80th District of North Rukongai.
They fought for centuries before learning their sword's name, Nozarashi.
The scar-faced, battle-hungry Captain of the 11th Division.
Official databooks state their absolute favorite food is Taiyaki.
They were originally the 6th Seat of the 11th Division before moving up.
They fought their own Captain during the Soul Society rescue arc.
Their Zanpakutō, Zabimaru, takes the form of a skeletal snake-sword.
The red-headed, tattooed Lieutenant of the 6th Division.
The only character whose Shikai and Bankai share the spoken name, Minazuki.
The release forms are distinguished entirely by writing different Kanji characters.
They hid a chest scar under their captain's cloak to conceal a past sin.
They were the first person in history to hold the deadly title of 'Kenpachi'.
The gentle-looking 4th Division Captain who was secretly an elite killer.
This Quincy was chosen for the Schutzstaffel because Yhwach recognized his unique potential to survive any lethal environment.
They possess the Schrift letter 'D', granting the ability 'The Deathdealing'.
They turn harmless substances like blood into lethal poison by drinking it.
They fought a highly technical battle against Urahara in the Royal Palace.
The eccentric Sternritter who wears structural safety goggle glasses.
This character's hollow hole is located through their lower neck.
The only Espada who achieves a secondary release state called Segunda Etapa.
They represent the aspect of death known as Nihilism.
They fought Ichigo atop Las Noches, forcing his Full Hollow awakening.
The pale, green-teardrop masked 4th Espada who throws spears of light.
They love playing classical music and frequently quote artistic poetry in battle.
A former Captain hollowified by Aizen, forced to hide as a rogue Visored.
Their Shikai, Kinshara, takes the form of a long golden whip with a flower tip.
Their complex Bankai utilizes a physical performance of illusionary music dancers.
The wavy blonde hair soul reaper who returned to lead the 3rd Division.
Their master, Sōken, died because Soul Reapers delayed their rescue.
They use a high-speed Quincy movement option called Hirenkyaku.
They defeated Captain Mayuri using a tool called the Sanrei Glove.
They were appointed by Yhwach to serve as the Wandenreich successor.
Ichigo's brilliant, glasses-wearing rival who is the main cast Quincy.
They spent over a century on Earth running a shady convenience shop.
The founding president of the Soul Society's Research Institute.
They invented the highly volatile, reality-warping artifact called the Hōgyoku.
Their Zanpakutō, Benihime, releases crimson energy shields upon command.
The brilliant, bucket-hat wearing ex-Captain of the 12th Division.
This weapon's real forging lake is hidden deep in the Royal Palace.
It was structurally shattered by Yamamoto during a past conflict 1,000 years ago.
Upon activation, it manifests four directional forms: North, South, East, West.
Its heat evaporates all water vapor in the Soul Society instantly.
The fire-type Bankai belonging to Captain-Commander Yamamoto, Zanka no Tachi.
The only Quincy in history born completely unable to manipulate Reishi.
They survived the Holy Selection because Yhwach needed their soul-sharing powers.
They carry the Schrift letter 'B' and act as the Grand Master.
They possess a signature, reality-altering shield capability called The Balance.
The long, blonde-haired elite Sternritter who serves as Yhwach's top proxy.
Born inside the prestigious Shihōin clan, inheriting the title Goddess of Flash.
They spent a century hiding out on Earth disguised as a talking black cat.
They refuse to use a Zanpakutō, relying on martial arts and Shunko instead.
She masterminded the secret escape of Urahara and the Visoreds long ago.
The purple-haired, highly athletic ex-Captain who loves teasing Ichigo.
Their physical spirit identity was hidden deep inside Ichigo under the name Zangetsu.
The absolute progenitor who gave birth to the entire Quincy race.
They launched an invasion from a hidden shadow dimension called the Wandenreich.
They use a multi-eyed divine ocular ability called The Almighty to rewrite timelines.
The supreme Emperor of the Quincies and main villain of the Blood War arc.
The only Visored member who uses a gold-ringed pendulum weapon to fight.
Their Shikai, Sakanade, creates a mist that flips an opponent's vision upside-down.
They served as Aizen's direct Captain long ago, completely falling for his illusions.
They wear a distinct flat cap and have a noticeable bob-cut hairstyle.
The smooth-talking blonde Shinigami who currently leads the 5th Division.
Their physical body is modified to instantly replace broken internal organs.
They carry backup organs stored inside their Lieutenant's flesh for serum repair.
Their Bankai manifests as a colossal, grotesque baby caterpillar that breathes poison.
They are responsible for performing brutal experiments on Quincy prisoners.
The terrifying, makeup-wearing mad scientist Captain of the Gotei 13.
This weapon's baseline Shikai release command is 'Sit Upon the Frozen Heavens'.
Celebrated as the most powerful ice-elemental sword in the Soul Society.
Its Bankai form manifests icy dragon wings on its young wielder's back.
In the Blood War, it achieved a mature, adult state that flash-freezes all matter.
The legendary ice blade Hyōrinmaru, wielded by Hitsugaya.
The only Fullbringer whose special item lets them insert themselves into memories.
Their unique ability, Book of the End, treats a sword bookmark as a rewrite tool.
They shattered Ichigo's mental state by making his friends think they were family.
They secretly served as a strategic execution puppet for Kūgo Ginjō.
The calm, book-reading rogue warrior who wears a distinct suspender outfit.
They were born a Fullbringer after a Hollow spirit attacked their pregnant mother.
They carry affiliation number 001 as the absolute founder of the organization Xcution.
Long before Ichigo, they were issued a badge to serve as the very first Substitute Shinigami.
They use a massive Fullbring broadsword weapon called the Cross of Scaffold.
The rogue leader who manipulated Ichigo in the Lost Agent arc to steal his physical powers.
A Zero Division member carrying the title 'Monk Who Calls the Real Name'.
They are responsible for inventing basic terms like Shikai and Bankai.
Their brush, Ichimonji, sprays black ink that strips a target of its name and power.
They fought Yhwach, nearly erasing his existence by renaming him a black ant.
The massive, bearded leader of the Royal Guard with oversized prayer beads.
This Sternritter possesses the Schrift letter 'F' ability known as 'The Fear'.
They utilize Reishi thorns that cause targets to suffer absolute psychological terror.
During the initial Wandenreich assault, they stole Byakuya Kuchiki's Bankai.
Their face is hidden behind a black leather mask featuring metallic studs.
The eerie Quincy warrior who was eventually incinerated by Rukia's new Bankai.
An elite Arrancar scientist who constructs custom testing chambers.
They represent the specific aspect of death known as Madness.
They were the 8th Espada, using a special clone ability called Fornicarás.
They died because Mayuri injected a drug slowing their perception of time.
The pink-haired hollow who wears glasses made from mask fragments.
